findings.title: Exact accent and scenario/animation selectors choose different functional picker flows
findings.reproduction: Public App::for_scenario(CapsuleMulti,Paused),120x40, Theme::junie downgradedAnsi256. Change only color.accent Indexed78→Indexed79; CtrlB then quote.
findings.observed: 78 selects static agent-card path, focus capsule-input, cursor(28,16).79 selects actual account-picker, cursor(39,6), title includes Account for Claude Code. All domain data/actions/size/capability equal.
findings.source: Host requires exact accent78 (or exact truecolorRGB) plus CapsuleMulti/Paused and size thresholds. The e937 OR adds ANSI256 to this inherited bypass.
findings.required_fix: Always open the same semantic agent-picker flow for these actions, independent of exact accent, scenario identity, or paused animation. Pass live offered-agent data through shared Picker/block APIs. Do not move/rename the selector into Termrock.

findings.title: Static reference painter replaces real picker state and repaints the underlying interface
findings.reproduction: Same accent78 flow; type QQQ, or independently press Down after opening.
findings.observed: QQQ never appears; Type to search remains. Down changes zero background cells, leaving hardcoded Claude selected. Painter accepts onlyUi and title, has no query/selection/item inputs; rows and metadata are fixed strings.
findings.source: Exact120x40 branch uses fixed CARD coordinates; fitted branch still paints the same fixed rows. repair_underlay rewrites menu gaps, pane text including running24tests and failure strings, and specific terminal cells after shell/layers draw. This is not merely legitimate terminal viewer/demo data.
findings.required_fix: Remove whole painter and correction passes in the same migration as live shared Picker adoption. App supplies semantic data/labels/actions; shared component owns layout,row parts,filtering,navigation,selection,scrolling,clipping,backdrop and cursor. Test interactions and changed data, not just opening image.
findings.introduced_vs_inherited: Painter existed beforee937; this change expands its color support and adds more correction rules instead of removing the bypass.

findings.title: Painted search field is represented by an undrawn one-cell focus/cursor registration
findings.reproduction: Open same ANSI256accent78 card; query public Harness.focus/area_of/cursor.
findings.observed: focus jackin.preview ▸ capsule-input has Rect{x28,y16,width1,height1}, cursor(28,16), while painted search spans the wide card.
findings.source: set_undrawn_top_bar_cursor temporarily promotes layer to top and calls register_keyboard_editor without drawing the corresponding input. It is invoked after the hardcoded card paint.
findings.required_fix: Real shared picker search must own its full resolved bounds,hit region,focus layer and cursor. Remove synthetic undrawn control calls after replacement; preserve ordinary capsule terminal input as a separate real component.

findings.title: Application-local baseline palette and whole-frame recoloring bypass shared semantic theme ownership
findings.source: apply_baseline_ladder rewrites fg[2..4],borders/backdrop only for this selected frame; baseline_256 maps literalRGBs; draw_capsule_scene recolors the complete terminal region after paint. New with_theme documentation explicitly describes one screen following a baseline ladder the shared palette does not.
findings.required_fix: Restore pinned authored capability roles and actual Picker/backdrop state recipes in the shared Theme family with independently resolved reference decisions. Apply general semantic variants, not app/test/frame variants or RGB selectors. A generic scoped-theme API may remain only for a legitimate consumer with consistent layout/input/render contracts; it must not legitimize this screen replay.
